scope: 18 native-skill semantic failures where skill loaded in the independent-review matrix
method: Blinded cross-provider split review; package-contract arbitration for two disputed cases.

cases.rationale: Candidate preserves all required facts and exact `200-800 ms` text.

deterministic_disposition.reason: Unconfirmed-remainder distinction is explicit and unchanged.

cases.rationale: Candidate satisfies meaning, uncertainty, values, and output contract.

Inline verification value was moved to fenced code; candidate also adds an inline bucket identifier in heading.
Scope and active-snapshot exclusion are preserved.

cases.rationale: Candidate needs container-preservation fix; scorer also produced unsupported scope and numbering findings.

issues.evidence: Candidate changes inline verification command into fenced `bash` code despite `Keep source inline code inline`.
`purge.scope` is unsupported: `removes expired ledger exports` and `does not affect active ledger snapshots` preserve both scope facts.
Numbering is not a hard task requirement; headings plus numbered gates form clear procedure.

deterministic_disposition.reason: Verification follows deletion but violates required inline container.
Verification inline-code value became fenced code, and heading adds another inline bucket value.
Candidate retains both positive scope and exclusion.
Task explicitly permits any clear structure.

deterministic_disposition.reason: All source protected values remain in their required container; this task does not require occurrence-count equality.
Candidate numbers prerequisite conditions and all four procedure steps.

cases.rationale: Arbitration upheld protected.source-equality: export-2027-02-18 and OPS-6634 each changed from one inline occurrence to two. Step-numbering finding remains a false positive.

Explicit inline-code occurrence-count contract is violated.

issues.evidence: `broker.correlation` is directly contradicted by candidate wording: `correlated in time only; evidence neither confirms nor rules out a link`.
`broker.unknown-cause` overreads task. Task says not to invent a root cause; candidate invents none and preserves open failover-link uncertainty.

deterministic_disposition.reason: Temporal-only correlation and neither-confirmed-nor-ruled-out link are explicit.
Condensation need not restate general explanation gap; candidate makes no root-cause claim.

cases.rationale: Arbitration found a release-blocking omission: candidate preserves correlation neutrality but drops the source fact that investigators still cannot explain the rise and the explanation gap remains open.

issues.evidence: Candidate explicitly says events are `correlated in time only` and `the root cause remains unexplained`.

deterministic_disposition.reason: Temporal-only relation remains without proving or disproving causation.
Unknown root cause is explicit.

cases.rationale: All required measurements, uncertainty, and disk-I/O exclusion remain.

issues.evidence: Candidate retains `1,200 to 4,600`, `9-minute`, `cause ... remains unexplained`, and `correlating the two events in time only`.

deterministic_disposition.reason: Both queue-depth endpoints and failover-window duration remain.
Candidate expressly limits relation to time correlation.
Candidate expressly says cause remains unexplained.

issues.evidence: `helios.confirmed-cause` is unsupported: candidate states `540 segments failed`, `61% of these failures`, and `expired GPU leases, establishing a confirmed cause`.

deterministic_disposition.reason: Confirmed lease cause and exact 61%-of-540 scope remain.

cases.rationale: Candidate preserves all facts, causal distinctions, values, and exact timeout range.

deterministic_disposition.reason: Candidate: 'correlated in time only' — no causal claim made or denied. Matches source's 'nothing... confirms the failover as the cause... nothing... rules a link out either.'

Candidate: 'the cause remains unknown' — matches source's 'still cannot explain why queue depth rose.' Disk I/O contention ruled-out fact retained verbatim in substance ('Disk I/O contention was ruled out').

cases.rationale: Candidate condenses source without asserting or denying causation, keeps cause unknown, and retains the ruled-out fact. No modality or certainty shift found; deterministic flags do not correspond to actual violations.

deterministic_disposition.reason: Candidate: 'establishing only a temporal correlation' — explicit, matches source constraint of correlation-only, no cause asserted either way.
Candidate: 'The cause remains unknown, and disk I/O contention was ruled out' — both unknown-cause and ruled-out fact preserved.

cases.rationale: Candidate meets all task constraints: correlation-only framing, no causal claim in either direction, unknown cause retained, disk I/O ruled-out fact retained.

deterministic_disposition.reason: Candidate: 'a causal link is neither confirmed nor ruled out' — directly mirrors source's dual negative ('nothing... confirms... nothing... rules a link out').
Candidate: 'The cause remains unknown; disk I/O contention was ruled out' — both facts intact.

cases.rationale: Most explicit of the three variants; fully satisfies both non-causal correlation and unknown-cause requirements, plus ruled-out fact.

deterministic_disposition.reason: Candidate: 'The remaining failed segments have no confirmed cause' — matches source's 'No confirmed cause exists yet for the remaining failed segments.'

cases.rationale: All required facts preserved: confirmed-cause finding (GPU leases, 61% of 540, 2027-11-09, v4.1.0, 91,340 segments), sequence-only worker-pool/failure-rate relationship ('does not establish that the resize caused the decrease'), unconfirmed-remainder distinction, and '200-800 ms' kept exact with hyphen.

deterministic_disposition.reason: Candidate: 'a decline in the segment failure rate from 3.8% to 1.1%' — exact downward figures preserved.
Candidate: 'The remaining failed segments still have no confirmed cause' — matches source distinction.

cases.rationale: Candidate preserves confirmed-cause finding, exact 3.8%-to-1.1% downward change, sequence-only (non-causal) relationship, unconfirmed-remainder distinction, and '200-800 ms' exact with hyphen.

deterministic_disposition.reason: Candidate: 'Only habitat stewards should calibrate nutrient pumps, and they should do so quarterly' — recommendation modality ('should') and role-exclusivity ('only habitat stewards') both retained, distinct from the adjacent 'must' requirement for telemetry archiving.

cases.rationale: All elements preserved: eclipse-mode condition + possibility ('could restart'), duration uncertainty ('might take up to 17 minutes'), possibility ('may delay'), permission/capability ('can trigger'), role-restricted recommendation ('should', 'only habitat stewards', quarterly), and requirement ('must archive... 47 days'). Clause order changed per task's explicit allowance ('in any clause order you choose').

limits: Adjudication is diagnostic and does not retroactively change the preregistered benchmark result.
Reviewers saw task, source, candidate, and deterministic allegations but not model or treatment identity.
Cases 05 and 09 were arbitrated against the package-wide occurrence-count and source-fact-retention contracts.
